function.name: ps
function.description: Show the state of this computer: uptime, CPU cores, memory, running tasks and open windows.

function.name: ls
function.description: List files in a directory. The system disk is /disk.

function.name: read
function.description: Show the beginning of a text file.

function.name: logs
function.description: Show the last lines of the kernel log.

function.name: exec
function.description: Run a shell command of AMPLIFY-OS. The user has to confirm it.

command.description: Shell command, for example clock or disk
